name: jdmail
description: AI-Powered Cold Email Outreach Tool for Job Applications

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const s = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'server', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const c = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'client', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"
